license_required.quote: No person shall act as a nursing home administrator unless such person has been licensed as a nursing home administrator under the provisions of sections 19a-511 to 19a-520, inclusive.

issuing_authority.quote: The Commissioner of Public Health shall issue a license as a nursing home administrator to any applicant meeting the requirements for licensure as specified in sections 19a-511 to 19a-520, inclusive.

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate degree in any area plus a course in long-term care administration approved by the department, OR a master's degree in long-term care administration or in a related health care field approved by the commissioner
degree_required.quote: Each such person applying on or after February 1, 1985, in addition to the requirements of subdivision (1) of this subsection, shall either (A) have a baccalaureate degree in any area and have completed a course in long-term care administration approved by the department, or (B) have a master's degree in long-term care administration or in a related health care field approved by the commissioner.

value: Alzheimer's disease and dementia symptoms and care
topical_requirements.quote: including, but not limited to, training in (1) Alzheimer's disease and dementia symptoms and care, and (2) infection prevention and control.

available.quote: In order to be eligible for licensure by endorsement pursuant to sections 19a-511 to 19a-520, inclusive, a person shall submit an application for endorsement licensure on a form provided by the department, together with a fee of two hundred dollars

requirements.value: Must hold a current license in good standing as a nursing home administrator in another state issued on basis of at minimum a baccalaureate degree and having passed the examination required for licensure in such state; must have practiced as a licensed nursing home administrator for not less than 12 months within the 24-month period preceding the date of application; must have received training or education in long-term care including Alzheimer's disease and dementia symptoms and care (or agree in writing to receive such training within 120 days of license issuance). Fee: $200.
